create_SequenceModel: create a SequenceModel LightningModule instance with a config and optional model config override
instantiate_datamodule: instantiate a datamodule from hydra config and register a datamodule resolver in omegaconf
warmstart_model: warmstart a SequenceModel by loading pretrained weights from a checkpoint path with optional post-processing
configure_optimizers: configure optimizers with parameter grouping and optional learning rate scheduler for a SequenceModel
run_training_step: run a training step on a SequenceModel that computes loss, updates metrics, and logs results
